rules.name: title-line.form
rules.wherePlain: The title line of a course block
rules.description: Every title line has the same form: subject, number, name, an optional transfer tag in brackets, and credit. This rule only checks that form; the rules below read the parts.

rules.name: title-line.code
rules.wherePlain: The title line of a course block
rules.description: The title line begins with the course code: a subject of three or four capital letters, then a five-character number, then a full stop. An H in fourth place marks an honors course; a V in last place marks variable credit.

rules.name: title-line.name
rules.wherePlain: The title line of a course block
rules.description: The name is everything between the course code and the credit statement, leaving out the transfer tag in brackets if there is one.

rules.name: title-line.credit
rules.wherePlain: The title line of a course block
rules.description: The title line of every course block ends with a credit statement. The rule reads the number before “Hour” or “Hours”. Two numbers joined by a hyphen are a range.

rules.name: title-line.acts
rules.wherePlain: The title line of a course block
rules.description: Some title lines carry a transfer tag in brackets, in three spellings: “ACTS Equivalency =”, “ACTS Equiv=” and “ACTS =”. What follows the equals sign is the course's number in the Arkansas Course Transfer System.

rules.name: description.whole
rules.wherePlain: The description paragraph of a course block
rules.description: The description is the whole paragraph beneath the title line, word for word, including its labelled sentences (decision D3).

rules.name: description.prerequisite
rules.wherePlain: The description paragraph of a course block
rules.description: A sentence that opens with the label “Prerequisite:”. It runs until the next labelled sentence, the “(Typically offered…)” note, or the end of the paragraph.

rules.name: description.corequisite
rules.wherePlain: The description paragraph of a course block
rules.description: A sentence that opens with the label “Corequisite:” (and not “Pre- or Corequisite:”). It runs until the next labelled sentence, the “(Typically offered…)” note, or the end of the paragraph.

rules.name: description.pre-or-corequisite
rules.wherePlain: The description paragraph of a course block
rules.description: A sentence that opens with a label meaning “before or alongside”. Four spellings are known: “Pre- or Corequisite:”, “Pre- or corequisite:”, “Pre or Corequisite:” and “Prerequisite or Corequisite:”.

rules.name: description.typically-offered
rules.wherePlain: The description paragraph of a course block
rules.description: Nearly every description carries a note in brackets, “(Typically offered: …)”, naming the terms the course usually runs in. The rule reads the wording; a table then maps the wording to a CTDL value.

rules.name: description.cross-listed
rules.wherePlain: The description paragraph of a course block
rules.description: A sentence of fixed form saying the same course is offered under another subject code. The courses it names are links on the page.

rules.name: description.equivalent
rules.wherePlain: The description paragraph of a course block
rules.description: A sentence of fixed form naming an equivalent course, most often a course's honors twin. The courses it names are links on the page.

rules.name: left-out.repeatable
rules.wherePlain: The description paragraph of a course block
rules.pattern: (?P<quote>May be repeated for (?:up to (?P<hours>\d+) hours of )?degree credit\.)
rules.description: A sentence saying the course can be taken more than once for credit, sometimes up to a number of hours.
rules.leftOutReason: CTDL has no property for it. It remains inside the description.

rules.name: left-out.no-double-credit
rules.wherePlain: The description paragraph of a course block
rules.pattern: (?P<quote>Graduate degree credit will not be given for both [^.]*\.)
rules.description: A sentence saying graduate credit is not given for both of two named courses.
rules.leftOutReason: No CTDL property found. It remains inside the description.

rules.name: left-out.contact-hours
rules.wherePlain: The description paragraph of a course block
rules.description: A sentence giving weekly lecture and laboratory hours.
rules.leftOutReason: A candidate for ceterms:learningMethodType; left for later.

rules.name: left-out.level
rules.wherePlain: The title line of a course block
rules.description: The first digit of the course number appears to track the level of the course.
rules.leftOutReason: Unverified (decision D11): ceterms:audienceLevelType would be a guess until the catalog's numbering policy is read.

rules.name: unrecognised-label
rules.wherePlain: The description paragraph of a course block
rules.description: Any sentence that opens with a label and a colon. Labels that no rule above recognises are counted and listed, so new variants are noticed.

rules.name: page.language
rules.wherePlain: The opening <html> tag of the subject page
rules.description: Every page declares its language in the lang attribute of its opening <html> tag. This is markup, so it cannot be seen on the rendered page.

rules.name: page.title-organisation
rules.wherePlain: The <title> element of the subject page
rules.description: The title of every catalog page ends with the name of the institution.

rules.name: page.edition
rules.wherePlain: The edition label in the page's side menu
rules.description: Every catalog page is labelled with its edition, for example “2026-27 Edition”. The rule takes the first such label on the page.

rules.name: catalog.credit-unit
rules.wherePlain: The introduction on the catalog's Courses of Instruction index page
rules.pattern: earns a specified number of (?P<quote>semester hours) of credit
rules.description: The title line does not say what kind of hour. The index page does, once, for every course: “Successful completion of a class usually earns a specified number of semester hours of credit toward a degree.”

rules.name: catalog.approved-for-offering
rules.wherePlain: The introduction on the catalog's Courses of Instruction index page
rules.pattern: (?P<quote>all courses approved for offering by (?P<organisation>the University of Arkansas))
rules.description: The index page says what the listing is: “all courses approved for offering by the University of Arkansas”. That one phrase supports two facts: the courses are current, and the university offers them.

tables.name: offer-frequency
tables.description: CTDL's list speaks in cadences (how many times a year), not in named terms. Each wording is mapped to the cadence it implies. Which terms they are is lost.

rows.because: Three starts a year. CTDL defines Quarterly as “typically occurring three or four times per year”.
